title: desmodium racemosum var. mandshuricum
intro: Desmodium racemosum var. mandshuricum, commonly known as Manchurian tick clover or Manchurian tick trefoil, is a plant species in the pea family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antipyretic effects, making it useful in treating conditions like fever, pain, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Manchurian tick clover include acting as an anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic agent, due to the presence of bioactive constituents like flavonoids and alkaloids. However, there is limited information available on the specific bioactive constituents of Desmodium racemosum var. mandshuricum, and more research is needed to confirm its therapeutic effects.
